regime_context: Hong Kong thematic landscape is narrow and defensive: only 3 of 17 themes clear the absolute-trend gate (Banks, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Conglomerates & Exchange), and Banks holds a dominant-if-not-yet-one-narrative lead (score 1.38 vs challenger Energy at 0.89, margin 0.49) with the strongest durability bar (0.69) and broadest breadth (0.769). Rotation is 'narrow' (18% eligible) and 'directional: false' with absorption at 0.46 — a mild concentration of leadership that is not yet reflexively feeding on itself. Note that nearly every theme lacks a proxy ETF (unscorable), so most leans below are qualitative and hard to grade.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Among the three trend-gate-eligible themes, High-Dividend Blue Chips offers the cleanest defensive expression in a macro backdrop where AI-tech and geopolitics share top narrative flow with unscheduled-surprise share at 1.0. Banks leads on rank and durability but is unscorable and has idiosyncratic beta to HK rates/credit; dividend blue chips (Telecom, Utilities & Income category) provide similar era-appropriate defensiveness with less single-theme concentration. Rank 3 and modest durability (0.56) are enough to register, but I lean low because breadth is thin (0.25) and the theme is not actually leading.
